mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (order_item_id, product_id, member_id, overall_rating, taste_rating, design_rating, service_rating, content, status) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{memberId}, #{overallRating}, #{tasteRating}, #{designRating}, #{serviceRating}, #{content}, 'PUBLISHED')
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(overall_rating), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' FOR UPDATE
